description.value:
(Prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can't Have Another Dragonmark Feat)

The Mark of Handling of House Vadalis manifests on your skin. You gain the following benefits.

Wild Intuition. When you make an Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Animal Handling) check, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

Primal Connection. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAnimalFrie]{Animal Friendship} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpeakwithA]{Speak with Animals} are always prepared for you. You can cast each of them once without a spell slot, and you regain that use when you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast them with any spell slots you have. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you take this feat).

Monstrous Connections. From character level 3, you can target a Monstrosity whose Intelligence score is 3 or lower with @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAnimalFrie]{Animal Friendship} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpeakwithA]{Speak with Animals}.

Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, the spells on the Mark of Handling Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

Mark of Handling Spells

1@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommand000]{Command}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar}
2@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.spells.Item.Aas6i0uCFP6uag7H]{Beast Sense}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCalmEmotio]{Calm Emotions}
3@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplBeaconofHo]{Beacon of Hope}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplConjureAni]{Conjure Animals}
4@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAuraofLife]{Aura of Life}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDominateBe]{Dominate Beast}
5@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAwaken0000]{Awaken}

Foundry Note

The effect Wild Intuition adds the 1d4 to the Nature and Animal Handling checks. The Spells of the Mark are not added to your class spell list automatically: prepare them from the compendium if your class can. Monstrous Connections is not automated: choose a Monstrosity with an Intelligence of 3 or lower as the target yourself.
